new_packages.label: שָׁלוֹם וְדִבּוּר וְחֲמִימוּת
new_packages.reason: These three concepts share the same essential nature in this Torah: they are all expressions of the same hot, connected, flowing spiritual force. (1) שָׁלוֹם and דִּבּוּר: 'עִקַּר הַדִּבּוּר הוּא מִשָּׁלוֹם' — the essence (עיקר) of speech is peace; they are two faces of the same reality, not cause-and-effect. 'מִי שֶׁהוּא בִּבְחִינַת שָׁלוֹם יָכוֹל לֵידַע כָּל הַדִּבּוּרִים' confirms that being-in-shalom IS having-access-to-all-speech: the same bechina. (2) חֲמִימוּת and דִּבּוּר: 'הַדִּבּוּר הוּא מֵחֲמִימוּת' — the canonical bechina formula X הוא Y. Speech IS warmth. (3) שַׁלְהוֹבָא דְּנוּרָא (flame of fire) and דִּבּוּר: 'תִּבְעַר אֵשׁ דִּבַּרְתִּי... וְהוּא שַׁלְהוֹבָא דְּנוּרָא' — the flame of fire IS the speech. God is named שָׁלוֹם and thereby identified as the One who knows all speech — this divine identification seals the package: shalom, dibur, and fire-warmth all converge in the same divine-positive domain.
source_quotes: מִי שֶׁהוּא בִּבְחִינַת שָׁלוֹם יָכוֹל לֵידַע כָּל הַדִּבּוּרִים שֶׁל כָּל הָעוֹלָם
חַם לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי בַּהֲגִיגִי תִבְעַר אֵשׁ דִּבַּרְתִּי בִּלְשׁוֹנִי

new_packages.label: מַחֲלֹקֶת וְקְרִירוּת
new_packages.reason: These two concepts share the same essential nature as the evil mirror of Package 1. (1) מַחֲלֹקֶת is the anti-shalom: just as שלום = דיבור by shared nature, machloket = inability-to-speak by shared nature ('עַל יְדֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְדַבֵּר'). The Torah does not frame this merely as cause-and-effect; it treats machloket as the structural opposite of shalom, the force that extinguishes the essence of speech. It is paired directly with מִלְחָמָה (war), which is the exact opposite of shalom. (2) קְרִירוּת (coldness) is the anti-חמימות: 'מִי שֶׁנִּתְקָרֵר וְאֵין בּוֹ חֲמִימוּת, אֵין יָכוֹל לְדַבֵּר' — cooling/coldness extinguishes the flame of speech; it is the same evil polarity as conflict, both being expressions of the same cold, disconnected, opposing force.
source_quotes: עַל יְדֵי מַחֲלֹקֶת אִי אֶפְשָׁר לְדַבֵּר
מִי שֶׁנִּתְקָרֵר וְאֵין בּוֹ חֲמִימוּת, אֵין יָכוֹל לְדַבֵּר

observations:
Torah #239 is a short but structurally complete Torah with a clear good/evil mirror. The dataset for this Torah is significantly underdeveloped: it contains only two eitza edges and zero bechina edges. The source text, however, contains rich and explicit bechina language establishing at minimum two conceptual packages.

Package 1 (good — שָׁלוֹם, דִּבּוּר, חֲמִימוּת, שַׁלְהוֹבָא): The Torah's core thesis is that speech, peace, warmth, and flame all share the same essential nature. The formula 'הַדִּבּוּר הוּא מֵחֲמִימוּת' is the clearest possible bechina statement. The identification of God as 'שָׁלוֹם' who knows all speech ('וּמַגִּיד לְאָדָם מַה שֵּׂחוֹ') and the gematria/acrostic proof (שָׁלוֹם = ראשי תבות of that verse) further confirms the structural identity of shalom and dibur. These four nodes form one bechina cluster: all expressions of the same flowing, warm, connected, divine speech-force.

Package 2 (evil — מַחֲלֹקֶת, קְרִירוּת): The Torah explicitly sets up the evil mirror. Machloket extinguishes speech not merely as a cause but as its essential anti-nature (shalom-and-speech share nature; machloket-and-silence share nature). Coldness extinguishes speech not merely as a cause but as the anti-nature of warmth-and-speech. This is the structural cold/dark mirror of Package 1's warm/light cluster.

The Torah's eitza flow runs: [Pkg 1: good] →eitza→ [prayer/tefillah outcome] with [Pkg 2: evil] as the blocking force. This maps onto the standard Breslov structure: positive package → positive outcome, with evil package as obstacle.

Note on the existing eitza edge (id 635, mishalom → dibur): This edge captures the directional flow aspect of the shalom-dibur relationship. However, the Torah also contains the bechina dimension of this relationship ('עִקַּר הַדִּבּוּר הוּא מִשָּׁלוֹם' describes essential identity, not merely causal flow). Both relationship types may be valid for the same pair of nodes, but the bechina edge is entirely absent and must be added.
